sample.description:
I'm looking for women who've been told their acne is "just hormonal" but no one's actually helped them fix it.

You know the drill:

Your GP offers you the pill or antibiotics.

Your dermatologist suggests another retinoid.

The internet says "cut out gluten" or "heal your gut" or "balance your hormones."

So you try it all.

And you're STILL breaking out.

You're not just tired. You're exhausted.

You're fed up with: 
❌ Treatments that work for 8 weeks then stop
❌ Waking up to new breakouts even when you're "doing everything right"
❌ Feeling like your skin is controlling your entire life

If this sounds like you, I made something specifically for you. → Keep reading.

I'm Cheryl, a skincare scientist and former acne sufferer.

I spent years on the same cycle you're on now - antibiotics, expensive skincare, cutting out foods, trying "all the things."

Nothing worked long-term. Until I discovered what was ACTUALLY happening.

I'm hosting a FREE 3-Part Acne Class where I'll show you exactly what I discovered.

🎬 You'll learn:
🔍 Why "healthy" women still break out (this isn't about eating better)
🔍 The 3 hidden traps that make treatments fail
🔍 What's really driving your acne (and how to finally address it)

This isn't another product recommendation.

This isn't a quick fix.

This is about understanding what's been happening in YOUR body all along.

🗓️ FREE 3-Part Acne Class

📍 Limited to women who've tried antibiotics, the pill, expensive skincare - and nothing's worked long-term

If that's you, use this link to get instant access to part #1: honestyforyourskin.co.uk/get-clear

You deserve to understand what's happening.

You deserve answers, not another bandaid solution.

Let's figure this out together 💛

sample.description:
Meet the Elements Collection, a fragrant ode to the Philippines, where every scent holds a story that is crafted to match your mood, your energy, your identity.

🌾 Banaue Bliss — For peaceful mornings & grounding days
Fresh greens and morning dew open the scent, settling into warm earthy woods.

Perfect for: weekend brunches, self-care days, nature trips, journaling mornings.
Why you’ll love it: it makes you feel calm, centered, and emotionally grounded...your natural warm aura, bottled.

🌿 Baguio Verde — For everyday freshness & clean confidence
Crisp pine and cool mountain greenery give a bright, refreshing start, then melt into airy, light woods.

Perfect for: workdays, meetings, errands, classes, casual dates.
Why you’ll love it: it’s extremely wearable....clean, long-lasting, and perfect for your daily go-to scent.

🌴 Siargao Escape — For carefree, social, and sunny moments
Fresh coconut water and sea breeze open the scent, settling into warm, sunlit tropical softness.

Perfect for: beach trips, vacations, café dates, weekends with friends.
Why you’ll love it: it lifts your mood instantly ...bright, breezy, and perfect for days you want to feel alive and spontaneous.

✅ High-strength 25% perfume oil concentration for exceptional longevity and presence.
✅ 8–10 hours on skin, even longer on fabric.
🇵🇭 Original artisan fragrances crafted by Filipino perfumers trained in Grasse, France

Choose the scent that fits the moments you live for.

Your signature awaits.
